a: Pick a real problem for real people, build a small version fast, charge early, and improve from feedback. Local businesses make good first clients.
Inflation is when prices rise over time, so each dollar buys less.
A stock is a small ownership share in a company. A simple long-term approach is low-cost index funds. This is general info, not financial advice.
Track your spending, pay yourself first by saving a fixed amount when you get paid, cut subscriptions you do not use, and build a small emergency fund.
A credit score shows lenders how reliably you repay debt. Pay on time, keep card balances low, and do not open many accounts at once.
A blockchain is a shared ledger of records chained together with hashes so it is hard to alter. Bitcoin is the first cryptocurrency built on one. It is very volatile.
